title: Federal Debt and Your Mortgage Rate: What Connects Them
description:
The @MarksEconomics debt story connects federal borrowing to the cost of financing a home. We examine its 2026 claims of $40 trillion in federal debt, more than $1 trillion in annual interest, and a 5.3% Treasury auction yield—not independently verified current figures. Then we unpack its account of retreating Treasury buyers, rising term premiums, and buybacks that fail to deliver lasting relief. Everyday examples explain why higher bond yields can mean lower resale prices, how Treasury markets influence mortgages, and why cash needs and affordable payments matter more than panic trades.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#MarksEconomics #MarkTilburyEconomics #USnationaldebtexplained #Housing #RealEstate
